title: Death checklist
note: Guidance, not legal advice. Please verify with a CA, lawyer, or local authority before acting on any legal or financial step.

steps.title: Death certificate collect karo
steps.instruction: Local authorities se death certificate aur certified copies collect karni hoti hain.

steps.title: Insurance claim initiate karo
steps.instruction: Policy insurer ko formal written intimation dena hota hai aur claim papers collect karna hota hai.

steps.title: Bank and FD paperwork complete karo
steps.instruction: Nominee ko claim, transfer, or account update ke liye bank se contact karna hota hai.

steps.title: Vehicle RC aur insurance transfer check karo
steps.instruction: RC transfer aur insurance update ke liye RTO/insurer se process samjho.

steps.title: Property papers aur legal heir steps dekho
steps.instruction: Mutation, legal heir certificate, or property transfer se related steps ko verify karo.

steps.title: PAN and tax papers update karo
steps.instruction: PAN and tax records ko update karne ki process dekho, especially if the deceased had filings.

steps.title: Aadhaar update / record notice dekho
steps.instruction: Aadhaar se related record handling ko UIDAI notification requirements ke hisaab se check karo.
